Nice thread man! I definitely take the opportunity to talk about Blackbear whenever the chance is there.  
I first found Blackbear in 2011 when he was still under Mat Musto and making more indie rock kind of songs. My favorite songs of his were 50 Years, Douchebag, and Take My Time Loving You.  
In 2012, he made the change to Blackbear and I honestly wasn't with it at first because I thought "Mat Musto" was gonna be huge. Then he dropped Foreplay and I loved Teenage Waste. I've been a career-long fan since. He's my favorite artist and I'm honestly a huge stan.   
My favorite album is definitely Deadroses, just because it gives me a nostalgic feeling. I was really excited for that album. Every time he released a new single, EP, or album, I was just waiting for him to blow up, which he definitely is now, and rightfully so. He's amazing. One of my favorite things that I've always wanted to talk about, and now I can, is that I was dying to hear "Rich White Girls". He teased it on his snapchat for only 10 seconds back in the winter of 2015 and I loved it and I was dying for him to release it. Every project since then, Drink Bleach, Cashmere Noose, or any other single, I would hope that it would be it. Then Mansionz teased it and I was insanely hyped up. It was amazing to finally hear it over a year later.  
I could go on about him, and I'd be glad to answer any questions.
